Name: Custom Furniture - Bonsai Trees
Author: Xangriaa
Description:
This mod is a version of [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/481/?]Monteso's Bonsai Trees[/url] that is compatible with Custom Furniture. All sprites were created by Monteso. 

Requires: 
[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1254/?]Custom Furniture[/url] by Platonymous
[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1068/?]CustomElementHandler[/url] by Platnoymous 

How to Install: Place the Custom Furniture folder into Steam\SteamApps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods. 
If installed correctly, five bonsai trees will be purchasable through Robin.
